items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce (BlockStrap RCE)
items.summary: This update addresses multiple vulnerabilities, including a critical template engine injection flaw (CVE-2026-103849, dubbed 'BlockStrap') that could lead to unauthenticated remote code execution. Adobe recommends applying the update immediately, noting that new installs may remain vulnerable without a manual patch.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce (StyleSmuggler RCE)
items.summary: This emergency update resolves a critical vulnerability (CVE-2026-75650, dubbed 'StyleSmuggler') that could result in arbitrary code execution. Adobe is aware of this CVE being exploited in the wild, affecting all versions from 2.4.4 up to and including 2.4.9.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce (Incorrect Authorization)
items.summary: This update addresses a critical incorrect authorization vulnerability (CVE-2026-71362) that could allow an attacker to gain elevated access to sensitive resources without user interaction. This flaw has been added to the CISA KEV catalog due to active exploitation.

items.title: Unauthenticated unrestricted file upload
items.summary: This vulnerability allows an unauthenticated attacker to upload files with dangerous types, potentially leading to arbitrary code execution. It was part of a larger set of fourteen vulnerabilities addressed in the August 2026 patch set.

items.title: Cross-site Scripting (Stored XSS) leading to Arbitrary Code Execution
items.summary: A stored Cross-site Scripting vulnerability (CVE-2026-48414) was addressed in APSB26-92, which could lead to arbitrary code execution. This issue was part of a broader security update.

items.title: Cross-site Scripting (Stored XSS)
items.summary: This stored Cross-site Scripting vulnerability (CVE-2026-48413) was resolved in APSB26-92. Successful exploitation could allow an attacker to inject malicious scripts.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization
items.summary: An incorrect authorization vulnerability (CVE-2026-48415) was patched in APSB26-92, which could lead to security feature bypass or privilege escalation.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization
items.summary: Another incorrect authorization vulnerability (CVE-2026-48416) was addressed in APSB26-92, potentially allowing security feature bypass.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization
items.summary: This incorrect authorization vulnerability (CVE-2026-48411) was fixed as part of APSB26-92, which could lead to privilege escalation.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization
items.summary: An incorrect authorization vulnerability (CVE-2026-48412) was resolved in APSB26-92, potentially allowing security feature bypass.

items.title: SessionReaper: Unauthenticated RCE and Account Takeover
items.summary: Dubbed 'SessionReaper' by Sansec, this critical vulnerability allows customer account takeover and unauthenticated remote code execution under certain conditions. Automated attacks have been observed globally, with Adobe releasing an emergency fix in APSB25-88.

items.title: CosmicSting: Arbitrary File Read and RCE
items.summary: CosmicSting is a critical bug allowing attackers to read any files, such as passwords and other secrets, and potentially achieve remote code execution when combined with another bug (CVE-2024-2961). Sansec observed mass exploitation of this vulnerability.
